d: It’s our big midterm election show and Democrats have taken control of the House, Trump has been very quiet so far tonight as things haven’t gone his way, his priorities are insane and having nothing to do with what Americans actually want, DOJ monitors were sent to predominantly Democratic areas, we have a very tight mayoral election in LA, Idaho is voting on a state gun, we say goodbye to Mike Johnson as Speaker of the House, and a surprise visit from Jimmy’s assistant Natalie!
